title: Readiness Estimator: Seismic Cloak Foundations
definition: Estimates Seismic Cloak Foundations readiness from component maturity.
description:
The estimator scores the six Seismic Cloak Foundations components on the TRL 1–9 scale and averages them into a verdict: research phase, pilot phase, or deployment phase. Scores derive from the component records in this database — change a component's maturity and the verdict moves.

Honest scoring is the point: a foundation hulls that averages TRL 3 is not failing, it is three phases from deployment, and the estimator tells you which component drags the average down. Fund that one first.

title: Seismic Cloak Foundations Systems Simulator
definition: Simulates Seismic Cloak Foundations operating for a day.
description:
The simulator walks a Seismic Cloak Foundations installation through six operating steps, with seeded randomness standing in for real-world variation. Seed 39575 reproduces this exact run — change the seed in the program to explore other days.

Watch for DEGRADED steps: they mark where meta soils monitoring, foundation logistics redundancy, or wave guiding maintenance would intervene in a real deployment. A simulator that never degrades is lying; this one degrades about eight percent of the time, like early hardware does.

title: Seismic Cloak Foundations Master Roadmap
definition: The united roadmap for Seismic Cloak Foundations: prove, build, operate, compound.
description:
The master roadmap for Seismic Cloak Foundations — foundations routing earthquake waves away.

Phase 1 — Prove (meta soils): laboratory demonstrations of every component, replicated independently. No scaling until the physics is boring.

Phase 2 — Build (foundation logistics): pilot manufacturing and integration. The six pieces meet for the first time and the interfaces get honest.

Phase 3 — Operate (wave guiding): continuous real-world operation. Uptime, cost curves and failure data replace projections.

Phase 4 — Compound (scale testing): foundation hulls as everyday infrastructure. Costs collapse, standards settle, and civil-scale deployment begins.

Signature edition: phases overlap aggressively — integration starts on day one. This record unites the database: overview, research, components, milestones, demos and drills all point here.

Each phase has exit criteria.
Unites all 20 records.
